description: A Rive file from an https address whose state machine inputs follow Plux state (ANI-005).

props.name: url
props.description: The https address of the `.riv` file.

props.name: artboard
props.description: The artboard to show, or the file's default.

props.name: stateMachine
props.description: The state machine to run, or the artboard's default.

props.name: inputs
props.description: Number inputs of the state machine by name.

props.name: flags
props.description: Boolean inputs of the state machine by name.

props.name: triggers
props.description: Triggers by name; each fires whenever its value changes.

props.name: fit
props.description: How it fits its box, a Rive `Fit` name.

props.name: reduceMotion
props.description: `skip` freezes the animation under reduce motion, `ignore` keeps it playing.

props.name: semanticLabel
props.description: What the animation shows; without one it is hidden from screen readers.

events.name: onLoaded
events.description: Fires when the file is loaded.

events.name: onFailed
events.description: Fires when the file cannot be loaded.
